blocks.text: Andrea Brillantes’ upcoming psychological thriller “Laya” is set to hit cinemas nationwide on Nov. 25, with a new poster released ahead of its theatrical run. Rein Entertainment announced the release date alongside the film’s poster on Saturday, Oct. 4. “Hold your breath as the truth waits in the deepest waters,” the production company said. “Rein Entertainment presents LAYA starring Andrea Brillantes, JC Santos, and Anthony Jennings. Showing in cinemas nationwide this November 25.” Directed by Sigrid Andrea Bernardo, “Laya” follows a woman who drifts from place to place before crossing paths with a lonely ex-criminal who is suspected of having something […]...
